details: Codex automation can fail before awf starts when uv opens a restricted shared cache path such as /Users/nroth/.cache/uv/sdists-v9/.git. Decide whether scheduled prompts/docs should export UV_CACHE_DIR to a repo- or worktree-local writable path before uv run, then update docs/prompts/bootstrap validation together. Kept out of awf-fne because the current blocker is linked-worktree hook detection.
title: Define writable UV cache strategy for Codex automations
